issue.title: Create Appropriate DNS URL/redirects for Dronecode SDK
issue.body:
DroneCore has two entry points:
1. http://dronecore.io/ (website)
2. https://docs.dronecore.io (docs)

The website should be found at dronecode.org/sdk
- Is the plan to move this inside the dronecode site (abandon the old site?). In this case the actions are:
    - merge the dronecore.io page into dronecode site
    - create a redirect from dronecore.io to the new page on dronecode site
@mrpollo can you confirm the above? If that is correct I will start creating a new page in dronecode.org/sdk. You would sort out the redirect.

For the docs, I presume we just need new URL and redirect of old URL to that new URL. Not sure what was agreed - sdkdocs.dronecode.org? docs.dronecode.org? docs.dronecode.org/sdk?
